title: MEET & SPEAK - LANGUAGE EXCHANGE
description:
Meet & Speak by Citylife Madrid is a great way to meet new people while improving your language skills. Every Wednesday young international people come together to learn about each other's languages and cultures in a social & fun environment.

If you like meeting new people, speaking and practicing different languages, making new friends, or just would like to enjoy a drink in a nice international atmosphere, come down and join us at one of the most interesting, secret venues in Madrid's city centre: Calle 365!

The entry is completely free and there will be food & cocktails available too!
As the night continues, the venue will turn on the party vibes from 11 PM! With commercial, house & electronic music by different live DJs

description:
